First, to get the minor of ${b}_{32}$, we remove the $3$rd  row and $2$nd column: 

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}-1 & ∗ & 4 & 0 \\ 2 & ∗ & 0 & 7 \\ ∗ & 3 & ∗ & ∗ \\ -4 & ∗ & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{32}=|\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & 7 \\ -4 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${b}_{32}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{32} & =(-1)^{3+2}{M}_{32} \\  & =-{M}_{32} \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & 7 \\ -4 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$
